paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 1:11; perhaps it should read “in the name of R' Idi.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The named Midrash Rabbah -- TE text of Bamidbar Rabbah 1:11 explicitly reads Rabbi Pinchas bar Idi. Hyman’s possible “in the name of R' Idi” remains a conjectural correction, not that edition’s wording.

The supplied במ״ר supports the Bamidbar Rabbah expansion; earlier records truncated it to מ״ר and speculated Genesis Rabbah. The older machine פנחם and ו״ר אירי readings remain historical transcription uncertainties, not newly checked print. The title component of בש״ר remains R' because the named Pinchas title does not establish Idi’s title.
